entries.name: serialize-one-item-tuple-accept#0
entries.script: sigmaProp(Global.serialize(c) == Coll(0)) where c is a CONSTANT of type `(Int)`  // the one place a one-item tuple WORKS: DataSerializer writes a tuple's items and no type, so the write-side refusal that kills every box and transaction never fires

entries.name: serialize-pair-control-accept#1
entries.script: sigmaProp(Global.serialize(c) == Coll(0)) where c is a `(Int,Int)` CONSTANT  // the writable twin, and the cost the one-item row is read against
